summary: 1, Elijah is to reveal the priesthood; 2–3, The promises of the fathers are planted in the hearts of the children.
meta_description: An extract from Joseph Smith’s history relating the words of the angel Moroni to Joseph Smith the Prophet, while in the Smiths’ log home at Palmyra, New York, on the evening of September 21, 1823. Moroni was the last of a long line of historians who had made the record that is now before the world as the Book of Mormon. (Compare Malachi 4:5–6; also sections 27:9; 110:13–16; and 128:18.)
